caveat: Annual flows: latest matching 10-K fiscal year, Form 10-Q year-to-date excluded. Balance sheet values can be later quarterly instants. Capex is a positive cash outflow. Reported long-term debt excludes current portion when tagged LongTermDebtNoncurrent. Annual 5-year history is shown as supplied by 10-K; three-year median CFO-CAPEX is a provisional normalization. Diluted shares are weighted-average and must be verified. No automatic audited ROIC or investment advice.
